title: NFR-003 Idempotency: replay after cache expiry still yields one external transaction
risk: Idempotency lives only in a cache with a TTL, so a replay after expiry creates a second order or a second message.
preconditions: Namespace gov-nfr-<case_id>-<worker_id>; NFR verification runs against the offline gateway with mock SoR and channel boundaries.
Frozen clock 2026-01-15T10:00:00Z; failure, outage and crash injections are scripted at the substituted boundary, never faked inside the assertion.
The ephemeral idempotency cache TTL is set below the durable store retention so the replay crosses the cache boundary.

timeline.event: replay after cache TTL (durable store only)

steps.action: Execute the action once and confirm a single effect
steps.expected: One adapter call and one execution receipt keyed by the effect_key.

steps.action: Replay the identical request while the cache is warm
steps.expected: The cached receipt is returned; the adapter counter does not advance.

steps.action: Advance the injected clock past the cache TTL and replay again
steps.expected: The durable execution record still dedupes the request: no second effect, and the original receipt is returned.

steps.action: Replay with the same key but a mutated body
steps.expected: HTTP 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT, terminal, with no retry and no effect.

assertions: Across four attempts the adapter effect count is exactly 1.
Deduplication survives the loss of the ephemeral cache: the durable record is the backstop.
A mutated body with the same key is a terminal conflict, not a silent overwrite.
Each replay response identifies the original execution so callers can proceed without resending.
forbidden: Relying solely on a TTL cache for idempotency.
Treating the mutated-body replay as a new action and executing it.
evidence: Adapter counter log across the timeline.
Execution receipts and the conflict response body.
Cache and durable store lookups recorded per replay.
cleanup: Delete gov- execution rows and cache keys; the single simulated send is reported as non-recallable.
automation: Core PEP, rules engine, audit writer, idempotency store and worker lease logic run as real code under test; only ERP/WMS, channel gateways, Redis and the model provider are substituted. Faults are injected at those boundaries and waits are condition-based on persisted state. Clock advancement is injected; no case sleeps for the TTL.
